changelog:
- Major update: Complete overhaul for version 2.0.0, expanding guidance and frameworks for building SEO-driven pages at scale.
- Added detailed playbooks for different programmatic SEO patterns (templates, curation, locations, etc.).
- Provided step-by-step framework for research, data requirements, template design, linking, and indexation.
- Included robust quality checklists and common pitfalls to avoid.
- Clarified when to use this skill versus related skills like seo-audit or content-strategy.
- Explicitly covers task-specific questions and implementation output formats.
summary: When the user wants to create SEO-driven pages at scale using templates and data. Also use when the user mentions "programmatic SEO," "template pages," "pages at scale," "directory pages," "location pages," "[keyword] + [city] pages," "comparison pages," "integration pages," "building many pages for SEO," "pSEO," "generate 100 pages," "data-driven pages," or "templated landing pages." Use this whenever someone wants to create many similar pages targeting different keywords or locations. For auditing existing SEO issues, see seo-audit. For content strategy planning, see content-strategy.
